backend/main.mo: Actor manages user profiles with access control and includes feedback submission and admin-only feedback retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purposes of frontend components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base/theme CSS defining custom warm color palette and dark mode variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app through main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component handling page-based routing and theme provider setup.
frontend/src/components/ContentSection.t: Wrapper component applying consistent prose styling to content sections.
frontend/src/components/FeedbackForm.tsx: Feedback form with validation and submission via React Query mutation.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity login/logout button with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Site layout with header, navigation (including Ask Fred), mobile menu, and footer.
frontend/src/content/disclaimer.ts: Centralized disclaimer and notice text constants including Fred-related disclaimers.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, recreating it when identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and persistence of identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks that fetch the caller's user role and all feedback entries using the current actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubmitFeedback.ts: Provides a mutation hook to submit feedback and invalidates feedback queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base typography styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with mission details, legal notices, and disclaimers about the site's purpose.
frontend/src/pages/AdminFeedbackPage.tsx: Admin page that checks authentication and role, then displays feedback submissions or appropriate access messages.
frontend/src/pages/BeginnerGuidePage.tsx: Page presenting beginner Clash Royale tips through structured cards and content sections.
frontend/src/pages/DeckTipsPage.tsx: Renders a page showing example Clash Royale decks with stats, gameplans, strengths, and weaknesses.
frontend/src/pages/FredChatPage.tsx: Implements a chat interface where users ask Fred questions and receive responses from a local knowledge base.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the homepage with a hero section, game description, notices, and links to official Clash Royale resources.
frontend/src/utils/fredKnowledgeBase.ts: Contains predefined Q&A logic and keyword matching for generating deterministic responses for Fred.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters using query strings, hashes, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theme settings including custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Stores project state metadata, requirements, and feature definitions for building a Clash Royale info website without unblocking functionality.
